failure.stage: first episode retain before worker compilation or recall
failure.database_evidence: PostgreSQL rejected parameter $12 with invalid byte sequence for UTF8: 0x00

root_cause: The released sample contains C0 control codepoints, including NUL, which PostgreSQL text cannot represent.
single_change: Losslessly encode literal backslashes and non-whitespace C0 codepoints as visible \uXXXX sequences before both MemPhant ingest and reader prompting; the inverse transform is contract-tested.
scientific_effect: No source character is dropped or guessed, and all future arms consume the identical normalized text. Gold quarantine, expected IDs, k, budget, model plan, and gates are unchanged.
